scope: Every indexed person page assembled from people.json, family_people.json and family_groups.json
sourcePolicy: No unsupported personal fact may be invented to meet the word target. Each page prioritizes verified direct biography material and direct source passages mentioning the person. If direct evidence remains below 500 words, additional material may appear only in a separately labelled documentary-context section and must never be converted into personal events.
sparseEvidenceRule: When direct evidence is insufficient, the page must state the limitation and separate source context from direct biography evidence.
provenance: 100% of reproduced source text must retain source/extract identifiers.
